tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
The **Composite Resistance Index (CRI)** calculator is a quantitative precision oncology tool for early-stage *EGFR*-mutated non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) following 36 months of adjuvant osimertinib (ADAURA trial setting).
It translates physical transport parameters and co-mutational profiles into a calibrated risk metric that stratifies patient cohorts into actionable post-ADAURA maintenance tiers.
-----
**Biophysical Calculation Engine**
For each patient in a cohort, the tool computes:
1. **Spatial Decoupling Score (:math:`\\mathcal{S}`):** Derived from histological tumor cord geometry. In solid tumors, drug penetration from microvessels into tumor cords is governed by reaction-diffusion:
.. math:: C(r) = C_0 \\frac{K_0(\\lambda r)}{K_0(\\lambda r_0)}
where :math:`r_0 = 8.0\\ \\mu\\text{m}` is the microvessel radius and :math:`K_0` is the modified Bessel function of the second kind. The effective drug penetration distance is :math:`\\Delta r = 34.1\\ \\mu\\text{m}`.
- **Lepidic pattern (:math:`\\mathcal{S} = 0.00`):** Single-cell layer along alveolar septa (:math:`r_t \\le 10\\ \\mu\\text{m}`). Tumor cells are directly adjacent to capillaries; 0% sanctuary volume. - **Acinar / Papillary pattern (:math:`\\mathcal{S} = 0.40`):** Cords of intermediate radius (:math:`r_t \\sim 30\\text{-}40\\ \\mu\\text{m}`). - **Solid / Micropapillary pattern (:math:`\\mathcal{S} = 1.00`):** Large avascular expansile nests (:math:`r_t > 100\\ \\mu\\text{m}`). The limited drug penetration leave an unpenetrated outer sanctuary shell (:math:`r > r_{\\text{crit}}`) where persister cells survive.
2. **Genomic Co-Mutation Risk (:math:`\\mathcal{G}`):** - Pure *EGFR* mutant: :math:`\\mathcal{G} = 0.00` - *EGFR* + *TP53* co-mutant (impaired apoptosis): :math:`\\mathcal{G} = 0.50` - *EGFR* + *TP53* + *RB1* triple mutant (lineage plasticity / SCLC transformation risk): :math:`\\mathcal{G} = 1.00`
3. **Stromal Desmoplasia / Interstitial Pressure (:math:`\\mathcal{M}`):** - Loose / normal stroma (normal IFP ~0 mmHg): :math:`\\mathcal{M} = 0.00` - Moderate stroma (IFP 5-15 mmHg): :math:`\\mathcal{M} = 0.50` - Dense desmoplasia (high IFP > 20 mmHg, convective shutdown): :math:`\\mathcal{M} = 1.00`
4. **Composite Resistance Index (CRI):** Integrated vector score weighted by Cox proportional hazards regression:
.. math:: CRI = 0.47 \\mathcal{S} + 0.33 \\mathcal{G} + 0.20 \\mathcal{M}
-----
**Downstream Workflow: Direct Integration with Galaxy Survminer**
In high-throughput cohort workflows, the input dataset typically includes clinical follow-up variables (e.g. disease-free survival time and recurrence event status).
The tool **preserves all existing input columns** and appends 7 quantitative analytical columns: ``S_score``, ``G_score``, ``M_score``, ``CRI_Score``, ``Risk_Tier``, ``Expected_5yr_DFS``, and ``Actionable_Recommendation``.
This enables seamless downstream chaining into survival analysis tools:
.. code-block:: text
[Clinical Patient Cohort (TSV)] (with 'dfs_months' & 'recurrence_status') │ ▼ [CRI Calculator (Batch Mode)] │ Appends CRI_Score & Risk_Tier ▼ [Galaxy Survminer / R Survival] • Time variable: dfs_months • Status variable: recurrence_status (0=censored, 1=event) • Explanatory factor: Risk_Tier │ ▼ [Kaplan-Meier Survival Curves & Log-Rank p-value]
-----
**Clinical Risk Stratification Tiers**
- **Tier 1 (CRI < 0.30):** Low risk (expected 5-year DFS > 85%). Zero sanctuary volume; safe osimertinib cessation at Month 36. - **Tier 2 (0.30 <= CRI <= 0.65):** Intermediate risk (expected 5-year DFS ~ 55%). Cessation accompanied by intensified serial plasma ctDNA surveillance every 60 days. - **Tier 3 (CRI > 0.65):** High risk (expected 5-year DFS < 25%). Viable persister sanctuary; mandatory maintenance extension or anti-angiogenic vascular remodeling (e.g. ramucirumab / SG-ADAURA Arm B3).
